subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: In the context of procurement negotiations, what does the acronym BATNA represent?
options: Best Alternative to a Negotiated Agreement
Basic Administrative Tools for Negotiating Agreements
questions.explain: BATNA (Best Alternative to a Negotiated Agreement) is the most advantageous alternative course of action a party can take if negotiations fail and an agreement cannot be reached.
questions.subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: Why is establishing a strong BATNA critical before entering negotiations with a sole source vendor?
options: It legally forces the vendor to lower their price
It determines the maximum profit the vendor can make
It identifies the agency's 'walk-away' point and alternatives, preventing the agency from accepting a bad deal out of desperation
It waives the requirement to post a contract award notice
questions.explain: Without a BATNA, a buyer negotiating with a monopoly (sole source) has no leverage. Knowing the alternative (e.g., using an older system, delaying the project, redesigning the need) gives the buyer the power to walk away from unreasonable demands.
